phase_mapping.human: Exact user-marked boundaries, left arm only, two individually retained demonstrations. ep0036 excluded.
fabrics: withdraw start to withdraw end; final hold excluded
caveats: Fabrics block placement is analogous to, not equivalent to, ring/pole alignment and opening.
Controller alignment guards describe planned phase transitions, not externally annotated physical contact. Rotation alignment can begin before the guard.
Two human demonstrations cannot establish a population distribution; all ten simulation attempts remain visible, including one failed episode.
Scalar summaries do not average trajectory shapes. Each curve remains one individual phase.
Geometry uses5mm spatial smoothing with preserved endpoints; raw curves are available. Very short alignment motion is sensitive to smoothing.
Recorded simulation samples are post-step; their original extraction clock was shifted+20ms and the actual initial FK position was prepended.
Phase duration and path length differ; no duration normalization in actual-time plots. Fractional-time plots are labeled.

method.scope: Left-arm ep0019/0043 exact user labels; ep0036 excluded. Ten fabrics executions with prior approximate semantic mapping. No time or speed used in bend detection.
method.split_rule: Deep curvature valley below35% of two peaks; peaks separated>=10mm with prominence>=3/m. A region counts only if its integrated turning reaches15deg.
method.persistence: Default5mm event must match an interval at both2mm and10mm; intersection/union>=0.25 and center shift<=15% path length, one-to-one. Matching is a heuristic, not proof of physical intent.
method.sharpness: Report total turning angle, occupied arc length and effective radius=width/integrated curvature. Smaller radius is tighter, but not necessarily desirable. No universal broad/sharp label threshold.
method.endpoint: Last25% of each phase arc length, not measured object distance. Boundary-truncated events are flagged.
method.small_motion: Short phases and near-stationary correction paths are sensitive to sampling/jitter;2/5/10mm results all retained.
method.interpretation: Exploratory operational definition of a bend; counts depend on scale and thresholds. No task-general or population claims from two demonstrations.
